test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A 1.5 kg cake is divided equally among 10 boys. How much cake will each boy get?
solution:
**Given:**

Total quantity = 1.5 kg

No. of boys = 10

**Concept used:**

Average = Total of elements/No. of elements

**Calculation:**

1.5 kg = 1500 g

So Each boys = 1500/10 = 150 g

**∴ 150g cake will each boy get.**
